name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd

items.statement: Collection for Q1 FY26 was Rs 70 crores
items.quote: Collection for this quarter was Rs. 70 crores

items.statement: Net cash balance of Rs 905 crores as of August 2025
items.quote: As of August 2025, we are net debt-free with net cash balance of Rs 905 crores.

items.statement: Net IPO proceeds of Rs 732 crores after issue expenses
items.quote: During the IPO , we raised Rs. 792 crores through fres h issue and net proceeds post -issue expenses was Rs. 732 crores.

items.statement: Deployed Rs 88.70 crores of IPO funds till 22nd August
items.quote: We have deployed total funds amounting to Rs. 88.70 crores till 22nd August.

items.statement: Pet Care recorded sales of INR 38.17 lakh in Q1 FY26, up from INR 25.79 lakh in Q4 FY25
items.quote: During Q1 FY2526, the company recorded sales INR 38.17 lakh, showing steady growth from INR 25.79 lakh in Q4 FY2425 in one cat food flavour.

items.statement: Promoter holding in AEHL will rise from 71.9% to 72.7% after preferential allotment of 1,32,827 shares to AHCL at Rs 5,270 per share.
items.quote: Post the preferential allotment, the total equity share capital of AEHL is expected to increase from 47 lakh shares to 48.3 lakh shares. Within this, the promoter's holdin g will rise from 71.9% - 72.7

items.statement: AHCL will make a preferential allotment of 1,32,827 equity shares of AEHL at Rs 5,270 per share, amounting to Rs 70 crores.
items.value: 1,32,827 shares at Rs 5,270 per share, Rs 70 crores
items.quote: In relation to the preferential allotment, AHCL will require 1,32,827 equity shares of AEHL at a price of Rs. 5,270 per share, amounting to a total investment of approximately Rs. 70 crores.

items.statement: AEHL public shareholders will hold 4.6% stake in the combined entity post-merger; AHCL public shareholding will dilute from 67.6% to 64.5%.
items.quote: In terms of the post -merger shareholding of the combined entity, AEHL public shareholders will hold 4.6% stake in the combined entity. AH CL public shareholding will get diluted from 67.6% to 64.5%.

items.statement: Government of India provides Rs. 100 crore guarantee for defense CAPEX bank loans; no promoter security needed
items.quote: the Government of India gives a guarantee of Rs. 100 crores to the banks if I am taking the CAPEX. Bakulchandra Bhagat: Okay Sir. Ravindra Doshi: This is basically for factory and machinery. The Government of India gives a guarantee of Rs. 100 crores. I do not have to give any security to the bank

items.statement: Rights issue oversubscribed 2.13x; promoters fully subscribed their INR560 crore entitlement.
items.quote: The right issue has been a phenomenal success with one of the highest over -subscription recent times at 2.13x.

items.statement: Promoters fully subscribed their INR560 crore entitlement in the rights issue.
items.quote: Also, the promoters, having fully subscribed their entitlement of around INR560 crores, showcases their commitment and confidence in the company.

items.statement: Raised INR175 crores at Inox Renewable Solutions at a valuation of approximately INR7,400 crores.
items.quote: We have recently raised INR175 crores at Inox Renewable Solutions at a valuation of approximately INR7,400 crores.

items.statement: Raised INR175 crores at Inox Renewable Solutions at a valuation of approximately INR7,400 crores
items.quote: We have recently raised INR175 crores at Inox Renewable Solutions at a valuation of approximately INR7,400 crores.

items.statement: Invested over $135 million in Guinea operations as of today
items.quote: So we have already invested more than around $135 million as on today.

items.statement: Promoter pledged shares to fund personal property acquisition; pledge expected to be removed in 1-1.5 years
items.quote: Yes. So, we acquired some property on personal basis. For that, some fund was raised by pledging of the shares.

items.statement: Promoters have no intention to dilute equity for faster growth; target remains 25% growth without dilution
items.quote: No, we have 25% roundabout. To do 50%, we will have to dilute. We have no intention of doing that.

items.statement: Acquired 60% stake in Brij Bihari (paper company) via NCLT at face value; using land as collateral for bank guarantees
items.quote: Yes. So, we have acquired 60% stake in that company.

items.statement: EMS Realtech subsidiary holds land bank worth Rs. 200-250 crore; construction by EMS Limited; planning stage, drawings underway
items.period: planning stage, construction start by November
items.quote: The land bank will be around Rs. 200 crores, Rs. 250 crores.

items.statement: No working capital impact from rainy season; payment cycle unchanged as lower execution matches lower receipts
items.quote: No, no. We are even doing the less work. So, we are getting less payments. Our payment cycle is same still whether it is a rainy season or not.

items.statement: Fundraise (QIP/preferential) under process for HAM projects; timing depends on market conditions
items.quote: Yes, so, it is under process. You see, this whole process is guided by the market. So, as soon as the market stabilizes, and if any deal is finalized, then you will surely get to know.

items.statement: Promoter holding decreased to 70.52% due to preferential allotment of 3,06,000 shares and 51,500 warrants to promoters; no shares sold, and promoters bought ~42,000 shares from market.
items.quote: So we have not sold any single share, but we have added the equity by preferential allotment and also warrants to the promoters. So from 73.28% from promoter, we raised new 3,06,000 shares as a preferential allotment and also 51,500 shares as a warrant to the promoters. And also from market, we bought a considerable amount of shares. The detail is also there on NSE Portal. So at present, we are ho

items.statement: No further equity dilution planned for the current financial year ending 31st March.
items.quote: So any decision or discussion is not done yet. So at least, not for this financial year. Till 31st of March, we are not diluting anything. So we are not offering any preferential because the target which we are running behind, so it's far bigger than the valuation which it's today.

items.statement: Operating cash flow in H1 FY26 expected to be much better than last financial year.
items.quote: Yes, it will be much better than the last financial year. In H1, you will be able to witness it.

items.statement: Turned cash PAT positive at Rs. 17.5 crores versus a cash loss of Rs. 36 crores in Q1 FY25
items.quote: I am also pleased to report that through our consistent efforts and focus on profitability; we turned cash back positive at Rs. 17.5 crores versus a cash loss on a standalone basis of Rs. 36 crores in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: Promoter shareholding in merged entity will drop to 47.3% on fully diluted basis after conversion of all warrants and ESOPs
items.quote: the promoter shareholding in the merged entity on a fully diluted basis, after conversion of all the warrants and ESOP, will drop down to 47.3%.

items.statement: Approximately 4.25 crore new shares to be issued to Oilmax shareholders on net basis after cancellation of Oilmax's 2.72 crore shares in Asian Energy
items.quote: on the overall, on the fully diluted basis, including all ESOPs and all warrants conversion, the revised capital base of the company will be roughly around INR9.2 crores. So, in the net-net basis, the overall incremental shares will be issued roughly around INR4.25 crores.

items.statement: Oilmax is a net cash company with negative working capital; oil sold on cash-and-carry basis, gas billing cycle 15 days with payment in 7 days
items.quote: Oilmax is a negative working capital business. The oil and gas are being currently sold -- the oil is being sold on cash and carry basis. And the gas is a cycle of 15 days billing and the payment of 7 days.

items.statement: Deal funded through internal accruals; net debt-to-EBITDA remains sub 1x post transaction
items.quote: this deal is funded through internal accruals only. Our net debt-to-EBITDA continues to remain sub 1x.

items.statement: Tega to fund acquisition via preferential allotment and QIP of $248 million; promoter family to invest INR150-200 crores in preferential allotment
items.quote: For Tega, the transaction is proposed to be funded through a mix of equity instruments, including preferential allotment and qualified institutional placements, amounting to $248 million, with a debt infusion in Tega of about $112 million. The promoter family plans to take part in the preferential allotment and infuse INR150 crores to INR200 crores.

items.statement: Molycop FY25 EBITDA $173 million expected to generate $50 million free cash flow after interest and depreciation
items.quote: The $173 million EBITDA reported in financial year '25 is going to lead to $50 million of free cash flow after we provide for interest and depreciation.

items.statement: Molycop current operating cash flow about $110 million at $170 million EBITDA level
items.quote: So, if you see with the current levels, about at an EBITDA of about 170 million, and if you reduce the interest and depreciation as well, you get a free cash flow of about $50 billion. If I add up -- add back the depreciation, it's about $110 million.

items.statement: Independent director Anil Kumar Chaudhary resigned effective 8 September 2025; letter submitted to exchanges within statutory timelines.
items.quote: Mr. Chaudhary was appointed on Board on 20th August 2024. However, he decided to st ep down with effect from 8th September 2025. The contents of the letter required internal board -level deliberation. The letter was submitted to stock exchanges within statutory timelines

items.statement: Board appointed independent third-party firm to review observations within 30 days and report to board committees.
items.quote: An independent reputed third party firm be appointed to conduct a thorough review of the observations as soon as possible but not later than 30 days and present the report to the respective board committees.

items.statement: Mr. Dogra, an existing independent director, stepped into the Audit Committee effective 15 September 2025.
items.quote: Mr. Dogra, an existing Independent Director , has stepped into the Audit Commit tee with effect from yesterday.

items.statement: Export receivables of approximately INR 58 crores relating to FY23 shipments to an African customer were written off in FY25, leaving nil outstanding as of 31 March 2025.
items.quote: With an a uthorized dealer bank authorization for self -write-off under FEMA and RBI export directions, approximately INR58 crores was written off in FY25, leaving nil outstanding as on 31st March 2025

items.statement: Expected credit loss provision of around INR 18 crores recorded in FY24, first provision in September 2023 and remainder in FY25.
items.quote: KRBL recorded an expected credit loss provision under Ind AS 109, the value of which was around INR18 crores in FY24 with the first provision being recorded in September 2023 and the remainder value in financial year 2025.

items.statement: CSR spend of approximately INR 40 crores over past three years including current year; unspent balance including current year obligation is INR 37 crores.
items.period: past three years including current year
items.value: INR 40 crores spent; INR 37 crores unspent
items.quote: over the past three years , including the current year till date, the company has spent approximately INR40 crores on CSR and as of date there is an unspent balance including current year's obligation of INR37 crores.

items.statement: QIP of INR350 crores raised; INR310 crores used to repay Ascertis debt in Veranda XL; loan to subsidiary converted to equity to simplify merger
items.quote: So as part of QIP fundraise, so we did INR 350 crores of QIP, right, out of which we closed the majority of the Ascertis debt, which I was mentioning, INR310 crores.

items.statement: Loans and advances to subsidiaries for initial build-up
items.quote: So, mostly, this might be the fund that was going to our subsidiaries for initial days for our subsidiaries to be built up.

items.statement: Equity raising completed, no further equity raise expected for at least a year
items.quote: So, as of now, the equity part is completed. I do not think we will need any further equity raising in next maybe a year or so.
